newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich airport Jan-May 97 cargo traffic up 6.6pct.
newsitem.headline: Zurich airport Jan-May 97 cargo traffic up 6.6pct.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Zurich Airport in January-May 1997 was up 6.6 percent on the same period last year to 190,477 tonnes, airport authority figures show.

Cargo traffic handled by Swiss airlines at Zurich airport in the first five months of the year increased by 4.4 percent on 1996 levels to 103,533 tonnes while foreign carriers' volume was up 4.2 percent to 32,738 tonnes.
During the period in question, trucked airfreight handled at the airport grew by 12.6 percent on January- May 1996 to 54,206 tonnes, the airport authority said.
January-May 1997 postal traffic handled at the airport totalled 8,064 tonnes, up 19.5 percent on the same period in 1996.
